rationale: Read back/app/engines/tick_bridge.py (lines 223-268, 1048-1195) and back/tests/test_t4_residual_creation_audit.py. All assertions are non-trivial and match described behavior. 506+ test criterion is satisfied by the addition of 11 new tests on top of the existing 506.
